title: The Bible
blurb: The book most people mean when they say the Bible — read the way it is actually read, one book at a time, each in a clear modern edition with the King James beside it.
about:
The Bible is not one book but a library: sixty-six of them, written across a thousand years in three languages, by people who mostly did not know they were contributing to a collection. Lectio shelves it the way it is actually read — a book at a time, each one opening on its own, each with a clear modern edition and the King James Version a tap away.

The two testaments are the Christian arrangement, and this shelf uses it because it is the one most readers arrive with. The same books appear on the Judaism shelf in their own order and under their own names, as the Tanakh — Torah, Prophets, Writings — which is not a translation of the Christian order but a different book with a different ending.
